category.name: Screen Heresy
category.tagline: rule-breaking interfaces x pixel and print craft
category.description: Experimental sites that treat the screen as a medium to bend: fake operating systems, hand-drawn pixel worlds, risograph overprint and code-drawn art. Use it when the brand is the point of view, such as studios, festivals, games and artists.

designs.name: Dialog Box Studio
designs.summary: A teal Windows 95 desktop with icon column, beveled windows, a project folder, a polite fatal-error dialog and a working taskbar, all as the studio's homepage.
keywords: pixel UI font with heavy sans headline

references.title: Retro and old-computer UI collection (Windows 95, Y2K)
15 classic 90s websites and modern sites keeping the aesthetic alive
Portfolio built as a Windows 95 desktop

designs.how_to_build: Make a .bevel class from four inset box-shadows (black and white outer, grey and light-grey inner) and a .sunk class that reverses them. Title bars are a 90deg navy-to-sky gradient with tiny bevelled control buttons. Position windows absolutely and let them overlap with z-index. Draw icons as 16x16 SVG symbols with shape-rendering:crispEdges, and add a taskbar with a Start button and a sunken tray. Use a pixel font for UI labels and a very heavy sans for the headline with a stacked white and grey text-shadow.

designs.name: Windfall
designs.summary: A full-screen 4x pixel-art dusk orchard with a striped sun and dithered sky, a chunky stacked-shadow logo, an RPG menu with a cursor and a portrait dialogue box.

references.title: Pixel Hollow: an indie studio page as a playable 8-bit scene

designs.how_to_build: Paint the whole scene on a 320x200 canvas with fillRect helpers (sky bands with checker dither rows, disc() for sun and tree canopies, sprites from string maps) and stretch it to 1280x800 with image-rendering:pixelated. Overlay HTML UI: panels use four hard 4px box-shadows as a pixel border, the logo stacks several offset text-shadows in two oranges and navy, and the menu cursor is a CSS triangle. Keep to a 15-colour palette so every layer feels like one console.

designs.name: Overprint
designs.summary: A festival site for a print biennial: two huge condensed words printed in pink and blue plates that miss each other, halftone discs, a taped yellow marquee and printer's marks.

references.title: Risograph work on Behance (Mono Riso Print)
Designer spotlight: kinetic typography and print texture

designs.how_to_build: Render each giant word twice in two ink colours, offset by 10 to 20 pixels, both with mix-blend-mode:multiply so the overlap darkens like real overprint. Generate halftone discs on a canvas by placing dots on a rotated grid and scaling dot radius by a gradient function, then multiply the canvas over the paper. Add a rotated yellow marquee animated with translateX(-50%), a row of ink swatches, registration target SVGs and an SVG noise grain on top.

designs.name: Plotter Theory
designs.summary: A deliberately raw page: default Times, blue underlined links, a giant tight headline in difference blend colliding with a dense pen-plotter flow field and small generative thumbnails.

references.title: Generative landing page with WebGL (DEV Community)
The potential of generative art in web design

designs.how_to_build: Draw the artwork with a canvas: seeded value noise, thousands of short strokes that follow angle = fbm(x,y) times a few pi, a clear zone in the middle filled with concentric rings, and about 7 percent of strokes in one signal red. Set the headline in white with mix-blend-mode:difference and letter-spacing around -0.065em so it inverts over the lines. Keep the chrome deliberately raw: default serif, unstyled blue links, a plain bordered checkbox, mono captions and a rotated red sticker.
